title: Why Google Stores Billions of Lines of Code in a Single Repository
summary: Rachel Potvin describes the scale of Google's codebase and its custom monolithic source repository. She explains the reasons for the monorepo model, the tooling that makes it workable, and its tradeoffs.
why: The go-to reference in monorepo and trunk-based development discussions, recommended as a firsthand account of how Google manages source control.

quote.text: I'd recommend this video that describes it.
